tasks.title: Community garden funding priorities
tasks.instruction:
In your English class you have been discussing how to fund community gardens. Now your teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

Notes

Write about:

1. buying tools and seeds
2. training volunteers
3. ......................... (your own idea)

paragraphs: In your English class you have been discussing how to fund community gardens. Now your teacher has asked you to write an essay.
Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Community garden workshop review
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you attended a workshop or event at a community garden? Write a review for our specialist magazine.
Describe what the workshop involved, how well it was organised, and whether it helped you learn something new. Would you recommend it to other readers?
The best reviews will be published in next month's issue.

tasks.title: Encouraging community involvement
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town is planning a new community garden. How can we encourage more local people to get involved?
Write an article for the programme coordinator's website. Suggest one way to attract volunteers, explain why it would work, and describe what the garden could achieve for the community.
The best articles will be featured on the website.

tasks.title: Community garden funding debate
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Community garden funding
paragraphs: I heard your local council is debating whether to fund a new community garden. What's your opinion on this? Do you think it's a good use of money? Also, what practical benefits could a community garden bring to your neighbourhood? And how would you convince people who are against it?
Let me know what you think!
